headline: There's a beef about beef at the World Cup, as Argentina fans pour into Texas
context: It's about who produces the best, most succulent steaks, and how to prepare the meat. Argentina and Texas are two of the top cattle-raising areas of the world, where steak is deeply ingrained in diet and culture.
